```{=html}
<div id="map-aug07" class="day-map"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var map = L.map('map-aug07').setView([37.5500, 127.0200], 12);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OSM</a>'
  }).addTo(map);
  function dot(c) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:'+c+';border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)"></div>', iconSize:[13,13], iconAnchor:[6,6], popupAnchor:[0,-8] });
  }
  function hotelDot() {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#4A148C;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:#fff">★</div>', iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,11], popupAnchor:[0,-13] });
  }
  var pts = [
    { name:'🏨 Hotel — Voco Myeongdong or Gangnam (TBD)', lat:37.5572, lng:126.9680, hotel:true, url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Voco+Myeongdong+Seoul' },
    { name:'Ikseon Chwihyang 🍝 (Famous Pasta)', lat:37.5764, lng:126.9896, c:'#E53935', url:'https://share.google/APOmACS8D0vPGSFOc' },
    { name:'Seoul Forest 🌳', lat:37.5446, lng:127.0378, c:'#43A047', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Seoul+Forest' },
    { name:'Seongsu · Ggupdang 🍰', lat:37.5446, lng:127.0574, c:'#C62828', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Ggupdang+Seongsu+Seoul' },
    { name:'Rafre Fruit Dessert Cafe 🍓', lat:37.5448, lng:127.0580, c:'#AB47BC', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Rafre+Fruit+Dessert+Cafe+Seongsu+Seoul' },
    { name:'Soil & Tree ☕', lat:37.5445, lng:127.0575, c:'#8B6914', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Soil+Tree+Seongsu+Seoul' },
    { name:'Yunjudang 🍵 (PM Snack)', lat:37.5450, lng:127.0550, c:'#FFA726', url:'https://share.google/POc81bLY4RQHGNwya' },
    { name:'Korean BBQ Dr. Hong 🔥 (Dinner)', lat:37.5500, lng:127.0400, c:'#B71C1C', url:'https://share.google/YgAem3FjTp0fLv6lX' },
  ];
  window.pageMap = map; window.pageMarkers = [];
  pts.forEach(function(p) {
    var m = L.marker([p.lat, p.lng], { icon: p.hotel ? hotelDot() : dot(p.c) }).addTo(map);
    var html = '<b>' + p.name + '</b>';
    if (p.url) html += '<br><a href="' + p.url + '" target="_blank" style="font-size:12px">Open in Maps →</a>';
    m.bindPopup(html);
    window.pageMarkers.push({ marker: m, lat: p.lat, lng: p.lng });
  });
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
    <div class="event-name">KTX: Busan Station → Seoul Station</div>
    <div class="event-notes">High-speed train from Busan to Seoul. Target departure between 10:00–11:00 AM. Journey time ~2h 15m. Buy tickets on the Korail website or at the station. Busan KTX station is at Busan Station (city centre).

        <li>Check <a href="https://www.korail.com" target="_blank">korail.com</a> for tickets</li>
        <li>Seat reservations recommended — window seat for scenery</li>
        <li>Arrive Seoul ~12:30–13:00</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
```
